title: Nanobind® HT HMW DNA extraction using KingFisher Apex
author: Jae Hee Jang
materials: Add the following reagents in the order listed below. Add reagents directly to the liquid, not against the side of the well Add 10 µL of Proteinase K to each well. Add 5 µL of Buffer CLE3 to each well. Add 20 µL of RNase A to each well. Note: the sample and reagents MUST be added to the wells in the order described above
Verify the wavelength is set to 600 nm

If first time using Nanobind HT HMW DNA Extraction kit: Add the appropriate amount of molecular biology grade ethanol (96 – 100%) to buffers CW1 and CW2 before first use. Mark the bottles to indicate the date ethanol was added

steps.title: Gather required KingFisher plates
steps.instruction: Collect seven KingFisher 96‑deep‑well plates and keep them ready for the subsequent plate‑setup steps.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis/Binding plate with BL3
steps.instruction: When the instrument prompts (~00:35:00 after start), remove Plate 1 (Lysis/Binding plate), add 100 µL of Buffer BL3 to each well by gently dispensing against the side of the well, re‑insert the plate and press “Next”.

steps.title: Place Nanobind disks in wells
steps.instruction: Place one 3 mm Nanobind Disk into each well of the Lysis/Binding plate, ensuring the disk rests at the bottom and is not stuck to the side walls.

steps.title: Add elution buffer to elution plate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Buffer EB to each well of the designated Elution plate.

steps.title: Insert tip comb into tip plate
steps.instruction: Insert one KingFisher Apex 96‑deep‑well tip comb into the tip plate.

steps.title: Load wash buffers onto plates
steps.instruction: Load the following wash plates:

substeps.instruction: Plate 2 (Wash 1): add 700 µL Buffer CW1 to each well.
Plate 3 (Wash 2): add 700 µL Buffer CW2 to each well.
Plate 4 (Wash 3): add 700 µL Buffer CW2 to each well.

steps.title: Load instrument and start script
steps.instruction: Turn on the KingFisher Apex, select the “Bacteria_Nanobind_HT_APEX” script, press “Start”, and insert the plates in the order shown on the display, pressing “Next” after each plate. Prepare the Lysis/Binding plate (Plate 1) after all other plates are loaded.

steps.title: Resuspend pelleted cells in PBS
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of 1× PBS to each fresh or briefly thawed pelleted cell sample and pipette‑mix until the pellet is fully resuspended with no visible lumps.

steps.title: Add STET buffer, lysozyme, and optional enzymes
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of STET Buffer containing lysozyme to each resuspended sample, then pulse‑vortex at maximum speed for 1 s, repeat 10 times. For Gram‑positive bacteria, add 2.5 µL of reconstituted lysostaphin or MetaPolyzyme to the 50 µL STET‑lysozyme mixture.

steps.title: Set up instrument magnetic head and heating block
steps.instruction: Ensure the KingFisher Apex is equipped with the 96‑deep‑well magnetic head and the 96‑deep‑well heating block.

steps.title: Insert Lysis/Binding plate into instrument
steps.instruction: Load the prepared Lysis/Binding plate (Plate 1) into the instrument; the protocol will commence once the plate is loaded and “Next” is pressed.

steps.title: Add isopropanol to Lysis/Binding plate
steps.instruction: When prompted (~00:56:00 after start, ~00:22:00 after the previous addition), remove Plate 1, add 250 µL of isopropanol to each well by gently dispensing against the side of the well, re‑insert the plate and press “Next”.

steps.title: Complete run and remove plates
steps.instruction: At the end of the run (~01:40:00 after start, ~00:44:00 after the last addition), remove all plates as indicated on the instrument display and press “Next” to finish the protocol.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to storage
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate from the Elution plate (Plate 6) to a new storage plate or storage tubes. The Nanobind disks remain in the Elution plate; optionally move the disks to the tip‑comb storage plate (Plate 7). Use a P200 tip to collect any residual liquid on the disks.

steps.title: Pipette‑mix eluate to homogenize
steps.instruction: Pipette‑mix the eluate 10 times with a standard P200 pipette to disrupt any viscous “jellies”. Limited mixing does not affect DNA size but improves quantitation consistency.

steps.title: Rest eluate overnight at room temperature
steps.instruction: Allow the eluate to sit at room temperature overnight so that DNA fully solubilizes; visible jellies should disperse during this period.

steps.title: Pipette‑mix and analyze post‑rest sample
steps.instruction: After the overnight rest, pipette‑mix the sample 10 times with a P200 pipette and proceed to DNA recovery and purity analysis.

steps.title: Prepare STET buffer and lysozyme
steps.instruction: Prepare enough STET Buffer plus lysozyme for all samples, scaling the volumes according to the number of samples to be processed.

steps.title: Incubate lysozyme mixture at 37 °C
steps.instruction: After adding lysozyme, incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 10–15 minutes until fully dissolved; use the mixture on the day of preparation.

steps.title: Measure broth culture OD600
steps.instruction: Determine the optical density at 600 nm for each broth culture using a spectrophotometer (e.g., Pharmacia Biotech Ultrospec 1000).

substeps.instruction: Turn on the spectrophotometer using the rear switch.
Ensure the compartment is empty, close the lid, and press F2 to calibrate.
Fill a cuvette with 750 µL broth blank, insert with the arrow facing the back.
Close the lid and press the blank button.
Remove the blank cuvette, insert the first sample cuvette.
Close the lid, wait for the reading to stabilize, record the OD600 value, then remove the cuvette.
Repeat the blank measurement after every few samples and record each sample’s OD600.

steps.title: Calculate and pellet required cell volume
steps.instruction: Based on OD600, calculate the volume of culture to pellet so that 5 × 10⁸ cells (≈0.5 mL of a 1 OD600 culture) are obtained, yielding 5–25 µg DNA.

substeps.instruction: Round up to the next 50 µL (e.g., 325 µL → 350 µL; 350 µL → 400 µL).
If OD600 < 0.35, combine multiple pellets to reach the required cell number.

steps.title: Freeze pelleted cells (optional)
steps.instruction: Pelleted cells may be frozen at –20 °C for up to three months before continuing.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the pellet at 16 000 × g, 4 °C for 1 minute, then remove the supernatant with a pipette.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in Lo‑bind tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the rounded volume of broth culture to a 1.5 mL protein Lo‑bind tube (do not use the cuvette aliquot), then pipette‑mix 10 times with a P200 pipette until the pellet is fully resuspended without lumps.

steps.title: Add samples to Lysis/Binding plate
steps.instruction: Dispense each prepared cell suspension (from steps 7–9) into individual wells of the Lysis/Binding deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Decontaminate instrument with 15 min UV
steps.instruction: With the instrument empty and the door closed, run a 00:15:00 UV decontamination cycle from the KingFisher menu; do not start UV while samples are present.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with NanoDrop
steps.instruction: Measure nucleic‑acid concentration and purity using a NanoDrop UV/VIS spectrophotometer; acceptable ratios are A260/280 = 1.7–2.0 and A260/230 = 1.2–1.8.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit dsDNA BR assay
steps.instruction: Perform a Qubit dsDNA Broad‑Range assay (using a Qubit 3.0 and the dsDNA BR kit) to determine DNA concentration; do not use the HS kit as it may give unreliable results.

steps.title: Assess DNA size with Femto Pulse
steps.instruction: Run the Agilent Femto Pulse Genomic DNA 165 kb Kit for HMW DNA size QC: dilute the unsheared DNA to 500 pg/µL, mix by gentle finger‑tap, avoid standard pipette tips, and use a wide‑bore tip for dilutions. Typical extracted DNA size is ≥100 kb.
